regime_context: Canada/TSX detector shows two precious-metals groups (Silver & Royalties, Gold Miners) holding the top eligible ranks with similar scores, a broad-but-shallow rotation (8 of 16 eligible), and gate_helps=true meaning the absolute-trend discipline has historically cut drawdown on this market. Macro backdrop is dominated by geopolitics with an extremely high unscheduled-surprise share, which is coincident context, not a trigger.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the Silver & Royalties vs Gold Miners tie (margin 0.034, directional=false) resolves into a confirmed handoff — specifically whether Gold Miners' durability_bar (0.73) holds above 0.70 while its score overtakes Silver & Royalties by more than 0.10 for three consecutive sessions; if that condition does not appear, the watch simply retires.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners is eligible, ranks second with a score nearly identical to the leader (2.093 vs 2.127), has the highest durability_bar in the ranks (0.73), full breadth (1.0), and is not crowded (z 0.6). The leadership contest between it and Silver & Royalties is unresolved (margin 0.034, directional=false), so a split lean toward the slightly more durable, similarly-positioned group is reasonable as a trend-continuation view, not a return forecast.
theses.dissent: Precious-metals momentum itself may be short-lived; the macro backdrop is dominated by geopolitics with unscheduled_share 0.98, and a de-escalation headline could unwind the entire complex with no detector leg able to predict it.

falsifier.text: Gold Miners (XGD.TO proxy for the gold leg) underperforms the TSX benchmark by more than 5% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Silver & Royalties
theses.thesis: Silver & Royalties is the detector's headline leader (rank 1, score 2.127), eligible, with full breadth and no crowding flag. Its leadership is real on a focus basis, but I do not treat the rank as a return forecast — only as where flow and attention have concentrated. A modest overweight lean expresses trend continuation while acknowledging the near-tie with Gold Miners.
theses.dissent: The margin over Gold Miners is only 0.034 and the rotation is non-directional; a single strong day in gold could flip leadership, leaving a silver-specific lean wrong-footed.

falsifier.text: Silver & Royalties underperforms Gold Miners by more than 4% before the check-by date

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: Oil & Gas Producers is eligible and ranked fourth, but carries the only crowding flag in the eligible set (crowding_z 1.29, crowded=true). Under guardrails, crowding is a size-down caution only — never a fade or sell. An 'avoid' lean here means not adding fresh exposure to this theme while the crowding texture persists, not a short.
theses.dissent: The theme is still eligible and has positive momentum; avoiding it risks missing continuation in an energy-heavy Canadian market if oil holds.

falsifier.text: Oil & Gas Producers stays in the top 2 eligible ranks and crowded=false for five consecutive sessions before the check-by date

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
